question.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
question.problem: What is the minor of ${u}_{34}$ in  $U=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & -1 & 0 & 1 \\ 7 & 10 & 2 & 8 \\ 9 & -3 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]?$
question.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${u}_{34}$, we remove the  $3$rd row and the $4$th column:

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 & ∗ \\ 5 & -1 & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 8 \\ 9 & -3 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{34}=|\begin{aligned}2 & -1 & 1 \\ 5 & -1 & 0 \\ 9 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$
